items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I do many concerts with him

ctx.x: We played with the same group -- that group that I just mentioned, in concert in the states, too, from the Jersey Jazz Society, they brought us down, and recorded us, but it has never been released yet. I hope it will be someday; it's -- we were in jazz concerts in the states, too; we went down to Arkansas and so forth. And that's another group like the World's Greatest Jazz Band that we put together, and keep together.
I can't say enough about Pee Wee Irvin -- he's a great trumpet player, and we've been in constant contact over the years, and I do many concerts with him, so we're in personal contact at all times.
Now I'd like to get to Wild Bill -- Wild Bill
